disclosure: First Pitch earns a small affiliate commission if you buy through these links. It never changes the price you pay, and gear is never a requirement to run a good practice. We recommend the cheapest thing that gets the rep done first.

products.name: Adjustable Batting Tee
products.blurb: Height-adjustable rubber tee that survives a season of swings. The single highest-rep-per-dollar buy in youth baseball.
products.editor_note: What CHIPS-style coaches reach for first. Buy this before anything fancier.

products.name: Protective Pitching L-Screen
products.blurb: Pop-up L-screen so the coach throwing BP or feeding soft toss has a wall between them and a line drive.
products.editor_note: Safety gear, not a luxury. If an adult is feeding pitches, they need this.
products.safety_note: Required any time an adult feeds live pitches from in front of the hitter.

products.name: 7x7 Hitting Net with Bow Frame
products.blurb: Folding net that turns a backyard or garage into a hitting station. Pairs with a tee for solo reps.
products.editor_note: The backyard-practice unlock. Lets a kid get swings without chasing every ball.

products.name: Practice Baseballs (bag of 12)
products.blurb: A bucket's worth of balls so a station never stops to chase one. Get softer-core versions for the youngest band.
products.editor_note: Reps die when you only have one ball. Buy a dozen.

products.name: Soft Foam Training Balls (12)
products.blurb: Squishy, regulation-size foam balls that take the fear out of catching for 6-8s. Same reps, no flinch.
products.editor_note: For the youngest players, fear of the ball is the real opponent. Foam fixes it.

products.name: Disc Agility Cones (set of 25)
products.blurb: Mark stations, build baserunning lanes, set up footwork ladders. The cheapest way to organize a chaotic practice.
products.editor_note: Coaches underrate cones. They turn a field into stations a kid can read.

products.name: Weighted Throwing Balls (set)
products.blurb: Light-to-heavy ball set for guided throwing programs in older bands. Powerful, and easy to overdo.
products.editor_note: Only with a real arm-care plan. Numbers and rest days come from Pitch Smart, not from how the kid feels.
products.safety_note: Do not use under 13. Loads and rest days follow Pitch Smart limits, not soreness. Never use to push past a pitch count.

products.name: Pocket Radar Ball Coach
products.blurb: Pocket speed gun for exit velo and throwing velo baselines. Turns 'looks faster' into a number you can track.
products.editor_note: The measurement layer. Great for baselines — but track progress quietly, never as a leaderboard for kids.
products.safety_note: Use velo for baselines and progress, never to pressure a young arm to throw harder.

products.name: Youth Fielding Glove (pre-oiled)
products.blurb: Game-ready, broken-in-enough youth glove so a new player can actually close it. Sized by age band.
products.editor_note: A glove a kid can't squeeze ruins fielding reps. Fit matters more than brand.

products.name: Youth Catcher's Gear Set
products.blurb: Helmet, chest protector, and leg guards sized for youth catchers. Non-negotiable safety kit behind the plate.
products.editor_note: Catching gear is safety equipment first. Fit it correctly before any drill.
products.safety_note: Must be fitted to the player. Replace cracked helmets or pads immediately.

products.name: USA-Stamped Youth Bat
products.blurb: Length/weight-matched USA-certified bat. The right drop weight lets a kid swing on time instead of muscling it.
products.editor_note: Check your league's stamp (USA / USSSA / BBCOR) before buying. Too heavy is the #1 youth bat mistake.

products.name: Pitchback Rebounder Net
products.blurb: Angle-adjustable rebounder that throws grounders and pop flies back. The best solo-fielding tool for home reps.
products.editor_note: Turns 'go practice catch' into something a kid can actually do alone.

products.name: Resistance Speed Chute
products.blurb: Drag chute for short-burst speed work and home-to-first acceleration in older bands.
products.editor_note: Speed is a skill you can train. Keep volume low and quality high.

products.name: Padded-Lid Ball Bucket
products.blurb: Holds two dozen balls and doubles as the coach's soft-toss seat. Small thing, huge for station flow.
products.editor_note: The unglamorous MVP. A loaded bucket keeps every station moving.
